ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   C. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.

   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

3. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)

   B. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   D. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   B. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
